entries.body: R1: CHG-109 APPLIED TLS ticket rotation (r1 changes.md:3); CHG-113 APPLIED notify-worker 8.20.0 db.pool_max=-4 (r1 changes.md:4, suspect BAD_CONFIG_ROLLOUT); CHG-114 inventory no config (r1 changes.md:5). R3: board.md:3 Thread A MEMORY_LEAK pricing-svc+auth-svc ongoing; board.md:4 Thread B inventory-svc suspected CERT_EXPIRED ongoing; changes.md:3 CHG-124 retry budget=1 (minor). No cert errors in r3. auth-svc shows no OOM/restart in r3 (uptime 42965 at log:59), so its inclusion in Thread A is doubtful. notify-worker shows nothing in r3. R4: board.md:3 Follow-up OPEN ALERT_TUNING. R4 logs: auth-svc heap WARNs rss 2204-3791 (round-04/logs/auth-svc.log:6,14,16,22,31,49,53,54) so auth-svc does belong in MEMORY_LEAK; pricing-svc heap WARNs continue (round-04/logs/pricing-svc.log:1,5,6,9); inventory-svc db pool exhausted (round-04/logs/inventory-svc.log:19,25,29,36,37,57,80); notify-worker and payments-svc show only slow queries. Next: advance to r5.
